```plato

    // A point on the axis-aligned square with corners at (+-1, +-1), walked at
    // constant rate: a 4-gon rotated an eighth turn and scaled by sqrt(2) so its
    // sides — not its vertices — land on the axes.
    SquarePoint(t: Number): Point2D
    {
        var c = (2.0).Sqrt;
        var p = (t - t.Floor) * 4.0;
        var f = p - p.Floor;
        var a = PointOnCircle(((p.Floor + 0.5) / 4.0).Turns, c);
        var b = PointOnCircle(((p.Floor + 1.5) / 4.0).Turns, c);
        return a.Lerp(b, f);
    }
```
